title: Offshore Romance in Singapore with Genting Dream Cruise
highlights: Embark on a romantic getaway in Singapore, where enchanting experiences and cherished moments await amidst its vibrant cityscape
Enjoy the amazing Night Safari, where you can see nocturnal animals in an exciting and immersive adventure under the starry sky.
Experience ultimate relaxation on Genting Dream Cruise, with luxurious spas, captivating theaters, thrilling water parks, and delectable dining experiences.
Capture a stunning aerial shot of Sentosa Island during the popular Sentosa Cable Car ride, with panoramic views of the vibrant island.
inclusions: Flights included from Delhi to Singapore

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
The activities and tickets included in the package are non-refundable in case of cancellation
The dates for the activities cannot be changed as the number of visitors at some places are limited. The traveller have to pay an additional cost for the activities incase of rescheduling.
No bill will be reimbursed against any missed service/facility
Visa assistance will be provided but the visa cost is not included in the package.
All visitors have to carry a valid ID.
According to the Singapore government it is mandatory to buy a travel insurance.
The package cost does not include travel insurance and needs to be purchased separately.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Night Safari
days.desc: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport, you will board your flight to Singapore. After reaching Singapore, you will get transferred to your pre-booked hotel. Once you check in, rest and relax for a while. In the evening, you will be driven for a Night Safari, where you can enjoy walking through 7 unique trails, a 45-minute Tram ride, a fire dance show, and an animal show. After an exciting day, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Flight - Indira Gandhi International Airport to Singapore Changi Airport
Singapore Night Safari Tickets with Tram Ride - [Open Dated] Singapore Night Safari  Admission with Tram Ride

days.title: Transfer to Genting Dream Cruise
days.desc: Post check-out from the hotel you'll get transferred to the Marina Bay Cruise Center. Upon reaching the port, you will board the Genting Dream Cruise, enjoying a unique experience over the next 2 days. Sail through the clear waters and marvel at the city's beautiful scenery, along with the Singapore Flyer and Marina Bay Sands. On the cruise, you can indulge in the adventures of the rope course and zipline, or shoot at a 3 pointer at the Basketball court. Spend the night in your cruise cabin.

days.title: Leisure Day on Genting Dream Cruise
days.desc: Begin your day with breakfast onboard and spend rest of the day doing a plethora of activities on the cruise. You can start by going on a fun rock climbing adventure and playing golf on the Mini Golf course. Next, you can head towards the sports area and feel the thrill as you walk across the rope course. Enjoy an exhilarating experience on the water rides at the waterslide park on the cruise or go to the Zodiac Theater for an amazing live production show. Enjoy overnight stay on the cruise.

days.title: Disembark from Genting Dream Cruise | Sentosa Island Tour
days.desc: Today, you will disembark from the cruise at the Singapore Cruise Terminal, and get transferred to your hotel in Singapore. Upon arrival, you will check-in and rest for a while. Later, you will be driven to Mount Faber for your cable car ride to Sentosa Island. At Sentosa Island, visit the Madame Tussauds museum, admiring the wax statues of your favorite celebrities. Next, head to enjoy the laser show of Wings of Time. Later, you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
